title: Watchmen
about: Retired superheroes investigate the murder of one of their own.
cue: Serve the beans when Rorschach eats them cold from the tin.
faces: NEW YORK, 1985. CURRY BEFORE THE CLOCK HITS MIDNIGHT.
Ration sheet. Hot food. Eat it fast.
Cannellini beans in olive oil with garlic, rosemary and chilli, baked beans on the side.
Crisp chickpea flour onion fritters with mint yoghurt and tamarind chutney.
Chicken thighs simmered with ginger, garlic, garam masala, tomato and cream, rice and naan.
Butter cookies with yellow icing, a black smile and a drop of strawberry jam.
Coffee infused bourbon with maple syrup and bitters over a big ice cube.
Rorschach would rather pocket the sugar cubes.
Form LAB1985, rev. 2009. Return tray to the hatch. Rations subject to supply.
